link.title: Tutorials for Bitbybit Viewer
link.description: Every setting on the BITBYBIT VIEWER theme block, which presents a 3D model in a focused viewing context. Viewer sits between Preview and the full configurator: more presentation control than a simple preview, without the option panel and pricing machinery of a complete configurator. These pages document each field it exposes, covering the asset shown, camera framing and default view, lighting and environment, canvas dimensions across screen sizes, and which interactions a visitor can perform on the model.
